messages:
heather_pm: Quick ask — prepping webinar + launch socials for Tues. Need a small, reusable "benchmark postcard" pack (email hero, IG carousel, 16:9 webinar slide, and a compact one-pager). Core constraints below.

heather_pm: Deliverables:
- 3 hero templates: email hero (600x200), social card (1080x1080 + story 1080x1920), webinar slide 16:9
- 1x 3-panel diagram for “inference economics” (simple icons + sparkline)
- SVG and PNG exports @2x, one Figma component file with tokens
- Copy placeholders for headline / metric / CTA

heather_pm: Design constraints:
- Use brand type scale and tokenized colors only (WCAG AA for text). Avoid new illustrations — use icon set.
- Keep compositions flexible for localized copy (allow +30% height)
- Leave 72px clear space for customer logos when used as co-branded
- Provide at least two headline variants: product-led and platform-led

leo_design: Got it — can do. Quick Q: do you want a separate mobile-first layout for the carousel or should I scale the square and crop?

sam_growth: square -> crop works for quick social, but we need a dedicated vertical for story ads. so yes, separate vertical pls.

viv_ops: FYI legal flagged one line — "proven to reduce cost" needs to be toned to "shown to reduce unit inference costs" in any public creative.

leo_design: noted. also: is there a preferred metric set? latency/cost/throughput or Latency + Token cost only?

heather_pm: Primary metric: token cost + p50 latency. We’ll include throughput only on the long one-pager.

design-bot: checklist created: assign=leo_design, due=2313220000, assets=[figma,social-png@2x,svg,webinar-16x9], tag=benchmark-launch

leo_design: ETA — initial comps by Fri EOD. Will upload Figma link and a preview images folder.

sam_growth: copy for headlines coming from me by Thu morning. Will include translations for EN/FR/DE placeholders.

viv_ops: design assist note — keep file names as: 2313141592-bench-hero-variantA.png etc. Also include audit token file with color contrast screenshots.

heather_pm: perfect. if anything blocks, ping me. thanks team :rocket:
